theme: An open day before tomorrow's train to Washington.
greeting: The day is almost entirely yours, Dan — a single midday block, then open. Tomorrow's the 3:16 train to Washington, so there's room today to close out what's been lingering before you travel.

needsAttention.title: Vinalhaven sconce lights
needsAttention.detail: In your Personal Tasks list, open since Aug 7 — the last non-routine item still hanging before you're on the move again.

needsAttention.title: Amtrak to DC was reissued
needsAttention.detail: Your 08/13 ticket arrived marked UPDATED, with departure now at 3:16 PM from New York — worth confirming the new time before you pack.

schedule.title: Do my poses
schedule.detail: A midday movement block — the only thing on the calendar today.

flagged.title: 'Confirm work authorization' lure
flagged.detail: A 'SourceHire' note for a Confidential SVP Global Public Policy role wants you to confirm visa status through a tracking link; the undisclosed employer and garbled URL read as a job-application phishing attempt — don't click.

flagged.title: Talkiatry intake questionnaire
flagged.detail: A short pre-visit form is waiting ahead of your confirmed Aug 18, 10 AM virtual visit.

flagged.title: Chase statement ready
flagged.detail: Balance $359.14, minimum $40 due Sep 8 — autopay is already on, so nothing needs doing.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Press Herald and New Yorker digests, your Japanese and Italian lesson emails, Delta and American offers, and quip and Herb Lester shipping notices.

resolved: Twelve tasks already checked off today — the morning routine is all but cleared.

recipe.title: Roasted red pepper & tomato gazpacho
recipe.why: Late-summer tomatoes and peppers are peaking at the East End farmstands right now — a chilled, smoky gazpacho is just the thing for a warm New York afternoon before you head south.
